name: io.github.WYRE-AI/uisp-mcp
title: UISP
description: MCP server for Ubiquiti UISP's REST API - network/ISP infrastructure monitoring for MSPs.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UISP account token, generated in the UISP console under Settings > Users > API tokens.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the UISP instance this connector talks to, e.g. https://uisp.example.com. UISP has no shared multi-tenant endpoint; every deployment runs at its own instance FQDN. CRM calls use this host unless UISP_CRM_BASE_URL is set.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_CRM_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UISP CRM app key (X-Auth-App-Key), from CRM System > Security > App keys. Separate from UISP_API_KEY. Required for CRM tools.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_CRM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional CRM origin. Defaults to UISP_BASE_URL.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for CRM invoice day counts. Defaults to Pacific/Easter. Set to dueDate to use each invoice dueDate offset.

environmentVariables.name: UISP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose uisp_set_wifi_password. Any other value keeps the server read-only. A confirmed write still requires confirm:true on the tool call.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
